player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukinnyi {player_id} mu mukino wa Nim.
Lengo lyawe ni kugura ibintu byose byasigaye.
Ku ruhusa rwo, hitamo ikirimo kimwe gusa na kuhitira ibintu kimwe cyangwa ibintu byinshi kuva mu kirimo.
Tumia itorero '[pile quantity]', aho ikirimo ni inde ya kirimo na ubwoko ni idadi ya ibintu wakuhitira.
Kwa mfano, '[0 3]' kuhitira ibintu 3 kuva kwa kirimo 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nta buryo bwo kwimura bwemewe bwasanganywe. Koresha '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Umukinnyi {player_id}, Itorero siyo. Colonne {col} iko nje ya mipaka.

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.
